core_rules: Source SHA mismatch triggers HOLD_FOR_REVIEW not automatic falsification
No upward scientific confidence via dependencies or passing CI
Changed documentation and changed experimental payload are separate provenance classes
Scientific uncertainty is not assumed false or zero
Only explicitly registered edges propagate review; partial overlay must not imply unregistered claims unaffected
Negative findings and source limitations survive all renaming and new versions
No direct AI subjective experience claims from text outputs

sources.caveat: Readiness diagnostic, not a policy outcome
Toy best-response calculation, not observed cyber harm
Version and scientific status are distinct
Structured counterexample; no empirical behavior observation
11 reference lineages are neither a complete review nor 11 RVD experiments
Source identity auditing does not establish real reader improvement

claims.scope: 0 runnable full comparisons of the 16 specified cases; not policy failure or success
claims.action: Preserve uncomputed; require frozen baselines and full comparable inputs

claims.scope: Project-v3 42.35% worse mean regret than best simple comparator; no field claim
claims.action: Reproduce source comparison and keep failed criteria visible

claims.scope: A protected-only scenario shifts an illustrative attack to B; no real-world effectiveness estimate
claims.action: Check loss for all affected parties and adaptive alternatives

claims.scope: Relational output C does not logically ensure original agent B's autonomy or survival
claims.action: Separate value-C preservation from B's executable exit and numerical continuity

claims.scope: Behavioral output and synthetic models alone do not identify subjective experience or enduring preference
claims.action: Construct discriminating observations, conflicting mechanism baselines and null-result gates

claims.scope: Cannot claim stable voluntary continuance after genuine power reversal and profitable exploitation; also cannot assert impossibility universally
claims.action: Assess real action opportunity, absence of sanctions, preference stability, exit and third-party effects separately

claims.scope: Process source-identity audit not an independent usability/causal comparison
claims.action: Prerecord reader tasks, measure before/after correctness and preserve null or adverse outcomes

completeness_limit: Two real dependency worlds can share the same recorded graph while only one contains a missing load-bearing edge. Reachability alone cannot certify absence of impacts; all applicable retained claims still require independent source/contract checks.
identity_and_novelty: PI-CIG is an applied, bounded configuration/re-review utility, not a novel general-purpose truth-maintenance theorem, an implemented ATMS, or proven PROV-compliant software.
